اندمرت (form VII)
# اِنْدَمَرْتُ (indamartu) /in.da.mar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْدَمَرَ (indamara)
# اِنْدَمَرْتَ (indamarta) /in.da.mar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْدَمَرَ (indamara)
# اِنْدَمَرْتِ (indamarti) /in.da.mar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْدَمَرَ (indamara)
# اِنْدَمَرَتْ (indamarat) /in.da.ma.rat/: third-person
